""")
exec(open(WORK/'build2.py').read())
lab=np.load(WORK/'labels.npy'); N=len(lab); folds=np.load(WORK/'folds.npy'); Y=np.eye(8)[lab]
F=dict(np.load(WORK/'prep_feats.npz')); A=np.load(WORK/'v2_layer_scales.npy'); abar=A.mean(0)
Xs=np.concatenate([F[p][:,KEEP]*(A[:,k]/abar[k])[:,None] for k,p in enumerate(['m2','m6','m10'])]+[F['c12'][:,KEEP]],1)
acc=lambda o:round((o.argmax(1)==lab).mean(),4)
def cv(fitpred):
    o=np.zeros((N,8))
    for f in range(5):
        tr=folds!=f; te=~tr
        mu=Xs[tr].mean(0); sd=Xs[tr].std(0)+1e-6
        o[te]=fitpred((Xs[tr]-mu)/sd, lab[tr], (Xs[te]-mu)/sd)
    return o
def lda(s):
    def fp(Z,y,Ze):
        mus=np.stack([Z[y==c].mean(0) for c in range(8)]); Rr=Z-mus[y]
        # dual-ish: covariance d x d (3040) is ok
        S=Rr.T@Rr/len(Z); S=(1-s)*S+s*np.trace(S)/S.shape[0]*np.eye(S.shape[0])
        Wl=np.linalg.solve(S,mus.T); b=-0.5*np.sum(mus.T*Wl,0); return Ze@Wl+b
    return fp
for s in [0.3,0.6,0.9]: print('lda',s,acc(cv(lda(s))),flush=True)
def krr(gamma,lam):
    def fp(Z,y,Ze):
        d=Z.shape[1]
        sq=(Z**2).sum(1); K=np.exp(-gamma*(sq[:,None]+sq[None,:]-2*Z@Z.T)/d)
        sqe=(Ze**2).sum(1); Ke=np.exp(-gamma*(sqe[:,None]+sq[None,:]-2*Ze@Z.T)/d)
        Yt=np.eye(8)[y]; al=np.linalg.solve(K+lam*np.eye(len(K)),Yt-Yt.mean(0)); return Ke@al
    return fp
for g in [0.1,0.3,1.0]:
    for lam in [0.1,1.0]:
        print('krr',g,lam,acc(cv(krr(g,lam))),flush=True)
